# github_app (Data Source)

Get information about an app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "github_app" "foobar" {
  slug = "foobar"
}

output "app_details" {
  value = {
    client_id   = data.github_app.foobar.client_id
    html_url    = data.github_app.foobar.html_url
    owner       = data.github_app.foobar.owner
    permissions = data.github_app.foobar.permissions
    events      = data.github_app.foobar.events
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly name of your GitHub App.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client ID of the app.
- `created_at` (String) The time the app was created, in RFC3339 format.
- `description` (String) The app's description.
- `events` (List of String) The webhook events the app subscribes to. Global events (installation_target, security_advisory, and meta) are not included.
- `external_url` (String) The external website URL of the app.
- `html_url` (String) The GitHub URL of the app.
- `id` (String) The ID of the app.
- `installations_count` (Number) The number of app installations. Only returned when the app requests details about itself; otherwise defaults to zero.
- `name` (String) The app's full name.
- `node_id` (String) The Node ID of the app.
- `owner` (List of Object) The user, organization, or enterprise that owns the app. Fields that do not apply to the owner type are empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `permissions` (Map of String) The app's permissions, keyed by permission name with the access level as the value.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the app was last updated, in RFC3339 format.
